acceptanceCriteria: All action references in .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml use the declared latest stable Node24-compatible pinned SHAs for checkout, artifact upload/download, attestation, SBOM, and GitHub Release publication.
A fail-closed action runtime policy test detects stale refs, unpinned refs, missing workflow coverage, and a Node20 action runtime; both CI and release source-quality paths execute the policy.
Existing release workflow policy, version consistency static checks, documentation acceptance, and YAML parsing remain green after the ref upgrade.
Trilingual release documentation records the Node24-compatible action baseline and its purpose without changing the public v0.2.4 Release truth or installation contract.
The v0.2.4 tag target, provider Release assets, installed Runtime, Cargo package versions, and Rust source behavior remain unchanged.
WI-96 lifecycle evidence records the exact ref map, official tag identity, test output, and hosted-check handoff without modifying the main worktree.
goal: 消除 GitHub Actions 的 Node.js 20 弃用警告，同时保持发布供应链的 pinned action identity、fail-closed policy 和 v0.2.4 Release truth 不变。
intent: 将 CI 与 release workflow 的 Node20 action refs 升级为官方最新稳定 Node24-compatible refs，并用可执行 policy 防止回退。
outOfScope: changing global Agent or MCP configuration
